summary: Based on evidence through August 7, 2019, all existing covenants remain appropriate; no evidence of missed reporting, deteriorating leverage, or increased indebtedness risk warrants tightening, loosening, or adding protections.

clauses.rationale: Leverage ratio remains well below the declining threshold; no indication of approaching breach.
Annual statements for FY 2018 were released March 11, 2019, within the 90‑day window; assumption R03‑A04 is supported.
Q1 and Q2 2019 quarterly releases were issued within 45 days of quarter end; no reporting delays observed.
No evidence of monthly reporting failures; the covenant remains adequate.
Assumption R03‑A05 is supported; stable operations show no defaults or material adverse effect triggering notices.
VIP acquisition performed as expected (R03‑A06 supported); contingent note risk (R03‑A07) is already addressed in the indebtedness basket.

drift_reasons: Evidence shows timely financial reporting, leverage comfortably within covenant limits, stable business performance, and no new indebtedness risks that would require tightening, loosening, or adding covenant protections.
